en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an interior room of a museum filled with 19th‑century furniture and art: ornate carved chairs, a baroque chest of drawers, candelabra, small bronze sculptures, and many framed paintings. A large painting of an angel dominates the center wall. The reverse side identifies the place as the Gheorghe Tattarescu Museum in Bucharest and lists its address.
